briefs.title: Sky Documentaries - what we're looking for
briefs.summary: Bold, narrative-driven feature docs and limited series with scale (could become a scripted series or film); creative swagger, unrivalled access, UK resonance. Three focus areas: (1) personalities with UK fame and global recognition or astonishing life experiences; (2) true crime that takes you on a journey to the truth; (3) investigative thrillers retelling world-changing events with cinematic scale. NOT wanted: formatted or constructed docs, current affairs, presenter-led, specialist factual, anthology series.

briefs.title: Sky Entertainment - what we're looking for
briefs.summary: Scalable formats and talent-led series with a strong hook that get people talking; not panel or quiz shows.
